vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something new in place of something old
vocabulary.example: I need to replace my old phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to throw away or remove something you don't want
vocabulary.example: Let's get rid of these old boxes.
The depth of the pool is two metres.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to deal with something difficult successfully
vocabulary.example: She coped well with the new job.
His behaviour in class was good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not allowed; too bad to accept
a line of people waiting; to wait in a line
vocabulary.example: There was a long queue at the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a circle made by a line or rope
vocabulary.example: Tie the rope in a loop.
Keep me informed about the plan.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an amount of something ready to use
vocabulary.example: We have a supply of water for three days.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stay alive or continue in a hard situation
unhappy because someone has something you want
vocabulary.example: He was jealous of his brother's new bike.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say good things about someone
a person who works for free to help

fine_lines.title: Out of order (behaviour) vs out of order (machine)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: out of order لها معنيان: عن السلوك (في بريطانيا) تعني تصرفاً غير مقبول وغير عادل. وعن الآلة تعني أنها معطّلة. السياق يحدد المعنى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Out of order' has two meanings: about behaviour (UK) it means unfair or unacceptable; about a machine it means not working. Context tells you which.

examples.sentence: Pushing in the queue was totally out of order.
The lift is out of order, so use the stairs.

fine_lines.title: Out of your depth vs out of the loop
fine_lines.explanation_ar: out of your depth تعني أن الأمر أصعب من قدرتك أو معرفتك. out of the loop تعني أنك لا تعرف آخر الأخبار أو القرارات لأن أحداً لم يخبرك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Out of your depth' = something is too difficult for your skills or knowledge. 'Out of the loop' = you don't have the latest news because nobody told you.

examples.sentence: In the advanced class I felt out of my depth.
I was off sick, so I'm out of the loop - what happened?

expressions.phrase: out with the old, in with the new
expressions.meaning_en: said when you replace old things with new ones, often at New Year
expressions.example: I bought new shoes and gave my old ones away - out with the old, in with the new!

expressions.meaning_en: in a situation that is too difficult for you
expressions.example: When they started talking about engineering, I was out of my depth.

expressions.meaning_en: (UK, of behaviour) unfair or unacceptable; (of a machine) not working
expressions.example: It was out of order to read her messages without asking.

expressions.meaning_en: not knowing what is happening because you haven't been told
expressions.example: I've been away for a week, so I'm out of the loop.

expressions.meaning_en: to make a small amount of something last as long as possible; to just manage to earn enough
expressions.example: We eked out the last of the bread until the shops opened.

expressions.meaning_en: said jokingly when you think you did something as well as a famous person
expressions.example: Look at my cake! Eat your heart out, famous chefs!

expressions.meaning_en: a public thank-you or praise for someone
expressions.example: I want to give a shout-out to my teacher for her help.

grammar.title: Phrases with 'out of'
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم out of + اسم في تعابير كثيرة تعني 'خارج' حالة ما: out of your depth (خارج قدرتك)، out of the loop (خارج دائرة المعلومات)، out of order (خارج النظام). ويتغير الضمير: I'm out of my depth، She's out of her depth.
grammar.explanation_en: We use 'out of' + noun in many expressions meaning 'outside' a situation: out of your depth, out of the loop, out of order. Change the possessive: I'm out of my depth, she's out of her depth.
examples: They kept me out of the loop.
The machine is out of order.

questions.question: At New Year she threw away old clothes and bought new ones: ___ .
choices: out with the old, in with the new
questions.explanation_ar: out with the old, in with the new = استبدال القديم بالجديد.

questions.question: 'I'm out of my depth' means:
choices: The task is too difficult for me
questions.explanation_ar: out of your depth = فوق قدرتك.
questions.explanation_en: Something is too difficult for you.

questions.question: He pushed to the front of the queue. That was ___ !
questions.explanation_ar: out of order (عن السلوك) = غير مقبول.

questions.question: Nobody told me about the meeting. I'm ___ .
questions.explanation_ar: out of the loop = غير مطلع على الأخبار.

questions.question: 'Eke out' means:
choices: make a little last a long time
questions.explanation_ar: eke out = يقتصد ليكفي القليل أطول مدة.

questions.question: I scored a great goal. ___, Messi!
questions.explanation_ar: eat your heart out = مزاح بأنك جيد مثل المشهور.
questions.explanation_en: A joke saying you're as good as the star.

questions.question: 'The ticket machine is out of order' means it is:
questions.explanation_ar: عن الآلة: out of order = معطّلة.
questions.explanation_en: For machines it means not working.

questions.question: Which expression is about NOT KNOWING the news?
questions.explanation_ar: out of the loop = لا تعرف آخر الأخبار.
questions.explanation_en: Out of the loop = not informed.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: She is out of my depth.
She is out of her depth.
She is out of depth her.
